key.name: shortcut-search
key.summary: Shortcut that toggles the search popup

key.name: secondary-shortcut-search
key.summary: Optional second shortcut that toggles the search popup

key.name: preferred-monitor
key.summary: Monitor to open on (0 = primary, n = monitor n)

key.name: popup-at-cursor-monitor
key.summary: Open on the monitor under the mouse pointer

key.name: scale-width
key.summary: Extra width, as a fraction of half the monitor width

key.name: scale-height
key.summary: Extra height, as a fraction of half the monitor height

key.name: background-color
key.summary: Background colour (RGBA, 0–1)

key.name: text-color
key.summary: Text colour (RGBA, 0–1). Alpha 0 picks black or white automatically.

key.name: border-color
key.summary: Border colour (RGBA, 0–1)

key.name: border-thickness
key.summary: Border thickness in pixels

key.name: border-radius
key.summary: Corner radius in pixels

key.name: font-size
key.summary: Result font size in points (0 = theme default)

key.name: entry-font-size
key.summary: Search box font size in points (0 = theme default)

key.name: blur-background
key.summary: Show a blurred copy of the wallpaper behind the popup

key.name: blur-sigma
key.summary: Blur strength

key.name: blur-brightness
key.summary: Brightness of the blurred wallpaper

key.name: answers-enabled
key.summary: Look up answers online
key.description: Show Wiktionary definitions and Wikipedia summaries in the popup. What you type is sent to Wikimedia after you pause typing.

key.name: answers-language
key.summary: Wikipedia language code
key.description: Which Wikipedia to use, e.g. en, fr, de, pt, or simple for Simple English. Definitions are English only.

key.name: show-preview
key.summary: Show a preview of the selected result
key.description: A panel beside the results with details of the selected app, file or item. Needs a popup at least 640 pixels wide.

key.name: show-panel-icon
key.summary: Show a search icon in the top bar

key.name: use-animations
key.summary: Animate the popup opening and closing

key.name: animation-speed
key.summary: Animation duration in milliseconds
